title: Water safety Awareness
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Creative Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Walk round the school and point out the water points; songs and games on water safety stay away from real water.

skills.key_step: The child names the water points at school and which can be dangerous.

floor.question: Name a water point at home.
floor.answer: any of: a tap, a tank, a basin, a well

steps: Say what could be dangerous there.

misconceptions.ask: Name a water point in a school.
misconceptions.repair: Walk round the school and count the taps and tanks.

listen_for: no, it is only a trench
misconceptions.ask: After rain, a trench fills with water. Is it a water point to be careful at?
misconceptions.repair: Look at the trench after rain.

misconceptions.ask: How can the area round a tap be dangerous?
misconceptions.repair: Pour water on a smooth floor and walk carefully on it.

misconceptions.ask: Is it safe to climb on a water tank?
misconceptions.repair: Look at how high and open a tank top is.

checks.question: Name a water point at school.
checks.answer: any of: a tap, a tank, a well, a borehole

checks.question: Why can a tap area be dangerous?
checks.answer: the floor gets wet and slippery

skills.key_step: The child names water safety rules at school and tells a teacher about dangers.

floor.question: Where is the tank in our school?

steps: Keep away from tanks and ponds.

board.do: Should you climb up and close it?

listen_for: leave the tap running for the next child
misconceptions.ask: You finish washing your hands. What do you do?
misconceptions.repair: Show the puddle a running tap makes.

misconceptions.ask: The floor near the tap is wet. What do you do?
misconceptions.repair: Watch a toy slide on a wet surface.

misconceptions.ask: You see a tank with its lid off. What do you do?
Is it all right to splash friends at the tap?
misconceptions.repair: Ask: what happens to the floor and the water?

checks.question: What do you do after washing your hands?
What do you do if you see an open tank?
